attempts.title: bliki: Technical Debt
attempts.snippetPreview: Software systems are prone to the build up of **cruft** - deficiencies in internal quality that make it harder than it would ideally be to modify and extend the system further. Technical Debt is a metaphor, coined by Ward Cunningham, that frames how to think about dealing with this cruft, thinking of it like a financial debt. The extra effort that it takes to add new features is the interest paid
